scope: Actual label-free official map cartography on the existing 3D terrain and independent 2D background; bounded regional rendering, fallback and paused-state isolation.

build_info.emcc: emcc (Emscripten gcc/clang-like replacement + linker emulating GNU ld) 6.0.13 (e13ee988ce3d87a738dd8f3661d02223308c412a)

adaptations: Direct-drive design RPM replaces Aero-Matic tip-speed/gearbox heuristic
Retain pinned propeller geometry, inertia and Mach corrections; replace only fixed-pitch CP/CT tables
No tuning to a C172 glide ratio or aircraft-specific reference curve
propeller_adapter.scope: generic research fixed-pitch windmilling; not accepted aircraft data

checks: actual official PBF cartography renders outside EDFE; label-free 512px canvases retain independent pixels and a bounded reusable cache
level-16 imagery overzooms the declared native source ceiling of 15
34 controlled tile jobs evict old canvases at the 32-image cap while retaining one renderer
serial work queue stays at 48, dropped/view-cancelled requests use Cesium cancellation, and cancellation creates no extra WebGL contexts
network errors produce transparent fallback and degraded status instead of a false ready tile
disposal cancels active/queued work, removes the renderer and releases cache references
AbortSignal cancels active and queued jobs and removes the hidden renderer
style tampering is rejected before creating a renderer and imported style cannot fetch fonts or external resources

limitations: basemap.de cartography preserves regional map features but is not pixel-identical to TopPlusOpen; the existing raster has baked-in labels.
Germany vector data and sprites are live upstream editions; the local style is hash-pinned but no complete frozen geography snapshot is claimed.
The scene comparison uses actual public cartography/photography near the user point, after a short flight to dismiss the start card and then with a fixed paused pose.
The failure case deliberately uses fixture live WMS pixels, actual bundled starter photographs and a blocked vector service. It tests fallback, not real-service recovery or full world coverage.
Native physical heights, navigation and flight coefficients are unchanged. Embedded aircraft/runtime closure is not redistributed.
No global scenery, surveyed runway/obstacle, aircraft-performance, regulatory or training acceptance is claimed; peer remains pending.
